lines.text: The LORD is David's shepherd, makes him lie down in green pastures, and leads him beside quiet waters.
The LORD restores David's soul and guides him in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
David will fear no evil in the valley of the shadow of death because the LORD is with him.
The LORD prepares a tent before David in the presence of his enemies, and his cup overflows.
Goodness and mercy will follow David all his life, and he will dwell in the land of Canaan forever.
